The bowl is a stainless steel mixing bowl, roughly 22-25 cm across at the rim. I estimated each item from how much of the bowl it covers and how tall the pile is.

**Shredded carrot:** the pile covers about 12 cm by 9 cm and is loose, about 3 cm high. That is roughly 60 g.

**Cherry or grape tomatoes:** I count about 9, and at roughly 12 g each that is about 110 g. Some may be partly hidden under the carrot, so I settled on 100 g.
